newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SAIL hikes steel prices - paper.
newsitem.headline: India's SAIL hikes steel prices - paper.

text.p: Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) has hiked the prices of certain steel grades by 300 to 900 rupees a tonne effective this month, the Business Standard newspaper said on Monday.
The newspaper said the country's largest steel maker had increased its prices to offset a recent 12 percent rise in railway freight prices.
Steel makers TISCO and Essar Steel are likely to follow suit, the newspaper said.
It said SAIL had also decided to reduce current price rebates which had been used to clear inventories.
